messages:
anna_devx: heads up — customer reported 401s from JS SDK after yesterday's client-gen CI push
sam_backend: which customer? any repro?
maria_support: ACME reported errors hitting /v1/chat with our TS client; logs show Authorization header missing sometimes
anna_devx: they upgraded @redwood/js-client 0.12.0 -> 0.13.0 automatically via package bot
tyler_sdk: hmm 0.13 had openapi change: header canonicalization -> 'authorization' lowercase in codegen template
sam_backend: so server expects 'Authorization' case-insensitive per HTTP, but some proxies strip lowercase?
ops_oncall: proxies at some customers (esp older nginx) configured to drop headers that don't match case-normalization rules
maria_support: customer shared curl that worked, but client fails. here's failing request dump:
```
curl -v 'https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat' -H 'authorization: Bearer xxxxx' -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```
sam_backend: that is the issue — some infra normalizes to 'Authorization' only and drops 'authorization'
tyler_sdk: apologies — internal template change in ts-client generator lowercased header var when writing axios config. I can patch template now
anna_devx: we have a CI regen job that rolled clients yesterday; template change landed in openapi-gen v3.6.2
maria_support: customer requesting impact window and mitigation steps
tyler_sdk: immediate hotfix: publish 0.13.1 that restores header casing; also release patch for python/go clients if they share template
tyler_sdk: quick patch diff:
```diff
- headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
+ headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
```
deploy-bot: released redwood-js-client@0.13.1 — build 2023
sam_backend: we should add regression test in regen CI to run a simple request through our internal proxy emulator
anna_devx: agreed. also add a changelog note explaining header canonicalization risk
ops_oncall: FYI adding a proxy rule in staging to log lowercase headers so we catch this earlier
maria_support: I told ACME we'll roll them back to 0.12 or patch; they prefer patch
tyler_sdk: publishing npm package now and pinging major accounts
sam_backend: followup: can we detect header casings at runtime and normalize in gateway to be defensive?
ops_oncall: doable, but risky for perf. prefer client fix + CI test
anna_devx: action items: tyler publish JS patch (in progress), add CI regen test (sam), add changelog note(anna), add staging proxy log (ops), notify accounts(team:eng-sales)
maria_support: thanks all. I'll update customer and close ticket once they confirm 0.13.1 fixes it :thumbsup:
anna_devx: filing postmortem doc link when we have timeline — ping me if you want to be on it
